## Checklist
- [ ] Stayed within my owned files, or the owner of shared files is tagged as reviewer
- [ ] API contract unchanged, **or** `docs/api-contracts.md`, `backend/app/schemas` and `frontend/src/lib/api/types.ts` updated together
- [ ] New/changed behaviour has tests; `pytest`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] Migrations added with Alembic (no edits to existing migration files)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or sponsor documents committed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
